newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westpac cuts variable home loan.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westpac cuts variable home loan.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp said on Wednesday it had cut its standard variable mortgage rate by 0.51 percent to 6.69 percent from 7.20 percent as a result of the cut in official cash rates earlier.

Westpac said the new rate would come into effect for new customers on August 5, but existing customers would have to wait until September 8 for the change. Earlier, Westpac cut its First Option home loan to 6.19 percent from 6.69 percent.

Australia's central bank earlier on Wednesday eased monetary policy with a 50 basis point cut in official cash rates to 5.0 percent. National Australia Bank Ltd earlier cut its variable home loan to 6.7 percent from 7.2 percent while the Commonwealth Bank of Australia cut its standard variable home loan rate to 6.8 percent from 7.2 percent.
The Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd said it was reviewing its rates.
